title: The Beginning of Breaking the局
next_chapter_hook: From the depths of the Dragon Vein came the furious roar of the Eye of Heavenly Dao—it had sensed Chen Ji's true purpose

text.content: The turtle shell fragment warmed slightly in his palm, the blurry images still lingering in his mind. Chen Nian imprisoned at the blood-colored altar, and that name that chilled his heart—"Heavenly Fate Lock Key." As the Tianji Record Fragment trembled, an ancient line of text emerged: "To solve this局, one must enter the Imperial City's Forbidden Grounds." Chen Ji opened his eyes, sharp light flickering within. Three years of scheming, today finally the net was being drawn closed.

In the secret chamber at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back. Three jade slips floated before him, inscribed with the marks of Tianqing, Xuanwu, and the Holy Sect. "Ye Qing, are you ready on your end?" he asked casually. From the jade slip came the Demonic Path Saintess's cold voice: "I've diverted three-tenths of the Holy Sect's guards. The eastern forbidden entrance is passable. But there's one thing..." Ye Qing paused, "The Dragon Vein Altar is surrounded by the 'Net of Heaven and Earth Formation,' supposedly laid by Ling Yuan personally."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan? That old fox... Chen Ji sneered, "Does he think a single formation can trap me?" His fingers flicked gently, and a complex terrain map appeared in the jade slip, "Tell your Saintess to do one last thing for me—lure Han Lie to the western side of the forbidden grounds." Ye Qing fell silent for a moment: "You're going to use force against force?"

text.content: Not force against force, but making force collide with something harder. A mocking smile curved Chen Ji's lips. Han Lie, that brute, couldn't stand provocation—slight provocation and he'd charge forward without a care. And the formation Ling Yuan had set just happened to be designed to trap such rash fools. If the number one genius of the three major sects died in his own sect's formation, that scene would be quite spectacular.

choice.prompt: The rescue operation is about to commence, and Chen Ji must choose the entry method.

choices.description: Have Ye Qing create chaos to distract the guards while Chen Ji leads a small team through the hidden passage to infiltrate the core area
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing is exposed, the entire operation fails

text.content: Ye Qing's voice came through the jade slip, carrying a hint of imperceptible worry: "Understood. In three sticks of incense, there will be an 'accident' on the east side. By then, all guards will be drawn over." Chen Ji nodded slightly. He could sense the weight in Ye Qing's words—she was going to personally risk danger.

choices.description: Crush the guards with absolute strength, displaying Chen Ji's new posture, letting all see the true 'waste'
choices.visible_reward: Shock the entire audience, buying time for subsequent schemes
choices.risk_hint: May alert Ling Yuan's true body

text.content: Chen Ji put away the jade slip and took a deep breath. Three years—he had acted crazy and foolish in the Tianqing Sect, enduring cold eyes from all. Today, he would let everyone see—what truly meant playing the pig to eat the tiger. He raised his hand, and the fourth page of the Tianji Record glowed faintly in his sleeve. That was the forbidden technique he had just unlocked last night: "Tianji Transformation!"

choices.description: Use Han Lie's hatred of Chen Ji to make him spearhead and drain the formation's power, while Chen Ji reaps the benefits
choices.visible_cost: Han Lie may become alerted early
choices.visible_reward: Break through the barrier without spending a single soldier
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie dies, it may provoke the Xuanwu Sect to declare all-out war

text.content: Chen Ji took out a communication jade slip inscribed with Han Lie's characteristics and deduced a piece of false intelligence using the Tianji Record: "Secret treasure of the Tianqing Sect discovered in the Imperial City's Forbidden Grounds. Han Lie has rushed there overnight." That genius of the Xuanwu Sect hated being beaten to anything—this 'intelligence' was enough to drive him mad and charge straight into the trap.

Outside the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds, the night was ink-black. Chen Ji, dressed in night raid attire, was followed by seven elite death warriors—his strength cultivated in secret over three years. Distant commotion arose; Ye Qing had made her move. The guards surged eastward like a tide, and the patrol at the western forbidden entrance instantly thinned. "Move." Chen Ji uttered a single word and his figure ghostly swept into the depths of the forbidden grounds.

The forbidden corridor was dark and damp, both stone walls carved with obscure runes. Chen Ji's feet never stopped, the Tianji Record whirring rapidly in his Mental Sea, marking every fork, every restriction. But just as he was about to reach the core area, a sharp sword light struck from the shadows!

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, this old man has been waiting for you quite some time." The aged voice echoed through the corridor. Ling Yuan's figure emerged from the darkness, terrifying pressure swirling around him. His face wore a meaningful smile, "Did you think your little tricks could fool this old man? The timing of Ye Qing diverting the guards happened to fall in this old man's shift change window—do you think that's coincidence?"

text.content: Chen Ji's footsteps faltered, yet he showed no panic. He raised his eyes to Ling Yuan, the corner of his mouth curving into a smile: "Since Elder Ling knew long ago, why not stop me directly? You waited until I entered the forbidden grounds to appear." He paused, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes, "Could it be... there's something in these forbidden grounds that Elder Ling must witness me trigger?"

Ling Yuan's pupils slightly contracted, a barely perceptible fear flashing across that aged face. What Chen Ji said was precisely his greatest worry—the true abilities of the Tianji Record might only manifest when specific conditions were triggered. And everything he had arranged was merely chess pieces drawing Chen Ji toward that 'condition.' The old fox and the even older fox, their gazes met in this moment, each harboring secret intentions.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan has appeared to block the path, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Directly question Ling Yuan's connection to Chen Tianming's imprisonment, forcing him to show flaws

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze fixed on Ling Yuan, "Chen Tianming—that name, Elder Ling shouldn't be unfamiliar with, right? The one who was chosen by the Tianji Record thirty years ago, then abandoned by it... is now imprisoned in the depths of this forbidden ground. Elder Ling, you went through great lengths to bring me here—are you trying to kill me, or use my hand to release him?"

choices.description: Feign inability to fight and retreat, actually lure Ling Yuan to pursue, leading him into a preset trap
choices.visible_cost: Consume Tianji Record's Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Force Ling Yuan to reveal his true strength
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan sees through the disguise, the situation becomes dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji deliberately exposed a flaw, his form staggering backward. Ling Yuan indeed gave chase, palm wind fierce. However, the instant he stepped into a certain restriction zone, the surrounding runes suddenly blazed brilliantly! The position Chen Ji had been 'forced' to retreat to was precisely the formation's array point—he had been playing them along from the beginning.

Deep rumbling came from the corridor's depths, the entire forbidden ground began to tremble. Chen Ji and Ling Yuan both changed expressions—that was the direction of the core altar. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, the Tianji Record wildly warning: Chen Nian's aura was rapidly dissipating! No time! He hesitated no longer, the fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly unfurled, a power sufficient to transform the heavens and earth surged from within him.

dialogue.content: "Silly child, you've finally decided to use this move." The remnant soul of Master Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying both relief and worry, "Tianji Transformation will burn your Heavenly Fate Value; every breath is the流逝 of lifespan. But now... perhaps there is no better choice." Chen Ji gave no answer. His figure had already transformed into a流光, rushing directly toward the altar.

text.content: At the forbidden ground's core, the blood-colored altar. Chen Nian was chained at the altar's center,诡异的血色光芒 swirling around her. Her eyes were tightly closed, her face pale as paper, yet she still stubbornly pressed her lips together. Around her, four black-robed祭祀 were chanting incantations, the altar's formation had already operated to its extreme—the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" sacrifice was about to complete.

"Stop!" Chen Ji roared as he descended from the sky. The terrifying pressure of Tianji Transformation instantly shattered the surrounding black-robed祭祀. Those祭祀 who usually lorded over others, now fragile as ants before him. However, just then, a familiar figure stepped forward to block Chen Nian—that was Chen Tianming, his father! Chen Tianming's body was entwined with the same blood-colored chains as Chen Nian, yet his eyes were filled with resolve.

dialogue.content: "Ji'er... you shouldn't have come." Chen Tianming's voice was hoarse and weary, he smiled bitterly at Chen Ji, "The Heavenly Fate Lock Key requires two bloodlines... I willingly allowed imprisonment, to make the Holy Sect believe there was only one. Niannian... she is my final bottom line." Chen Ji's whole body trembled, he stared fixedly at his father, lips moved, yet not a single word could emerge. Three years of questions, resentment, longing, all transformed into silence in this moment.

text.content: Chen Nian, in her coma, murmured: "Brother... brother..." That weak cry struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing his churning emotions. He raised his hand, and the fourth page of the Tianji Record fully bloomed. A radiant light engulfed the entire altar, those blood-colored chains began shattering inch by inch. "I said," Chen Ji's voice cold as ice, "Whoever dares touch my Chen family, I will make them pay in blood."

choice.prompt: Chen Tianming and Chen Nian are simultaneously bound by chains, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Chen Nian is young and the core of the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' her crisis must be relieved first
choices.visible_cost: Chen Tianming continues to endure suffering
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tianming may not survive until rescue

text.content: Chen Ji poured all his power into the Tianji Record, precisely cutting the chains binding Chen Nian. The little girl's body softly collapsed into his arms, those closed eyes finally trembling open, tears streaming down: "Brother... it really is you..." Chen Ji held her tightly, voice hoarse: "Sorry, brother came late."

choices.description: Chen Tianming has been imprisoned for years, his physical strength at its limit, his bindings must be relieved first
choices.risk_hint: Forcibly breaking the formation may injure Chen Nian

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to his father. That usually calm face finally showed cracks: "Father... these three years, you've suffered greatly." Chen Tianming's old tears flowed, yet he forced a smile: "Silly child, you came just in time. Quick... save Niannian first... I can still hold on..." Before he finished speaking, the chains on his body suddenly tightened, blood splashing.

choices.description: With Tianji Transformation as the core, coordinated with the altar's formation backlash, break all chains at once

text.content: Chen Ji formed seals with both hands. The fourth page of the Tianji Record resonated with the altar's formation. Brilliant golden light swallowed the entire altar, all blood-colored chains shattering into countless fragments in the same instant! Chen Tianming and Chen Nian were simultaneously freed. Chen Nian threw herself into Chen Ji's arms weeping, while Chen Tianming staggered to stand, gazingcomplex地 at his now-grown son.

Just then, from the altar's depths came an earth-shaking roar. A completely golden dragon phantom surged from the ground—that was the Dragon Vein Spirit! Its eyes were crimson red, staring fixedly at Chen Ji: "You dare destroy the sacrifice... The Eye of Heavenly Dao will not spare you!" Before the words finished, the forbidden ground began剧烈震动, auras from various forces simultaneously flooded in—the Dragon Vein contest had officially begun!

Chen Ji supported his father with one hand, cradled his sister with the other, looking around. Ling Yuan's figure had vanished, replaced by experts pouring in from all directions—Xuanwu Sect, Holy Sect, even scouts from other hidden forces. The corner of his mouth curved into a mocking smile: "Want to compete for the Dragon Vein?" Hesneeredwhispered, "Then let's see who has the ability." The Tianji Record Fragment flickered again, Chen Ji's eyes reflecting无数 future possibilities—and this time, he finally stood at the chessboard's center, becoming the Chess Player.
